subject: [Innovation] New Solar Technology for DynaTrap 2026 Lineup?
body:
Hi Robert,

I have been following Woodstream's leadership in the mosquito control space, particularly with DynaTrap's expansion into multi-layer protection.

As a specialized factory that pioneered solar mosquito killer lamps in 2020, we have developed a new 4500V high-efficiency solar model that matches the performance of traditional grid-powered units while being 100% sustainable.

Given your role in global sourcing, I thought you might be looking for a unique solar addition to differentiate your 2026 catalog.

Would you be open to a quick look at our latest technical specs? Just reply "YES" and I will send over the PDF.

Best regards,

[My Name]
XPES Factory Team
